"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for tighter sanctions against Iran and the companies with business operations in or with Iran.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to entering into a presidential-level, unconditional dialogue with the regime in Iran until it takes steps to improve its behavior, particularly with respect to support of terrorism and suspension of its efforts to enrich uranium.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American people believe Washington is broken.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Short-term politics overshadow the long-term interests of the nation.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The national legislature uses a budget process devised long before the Internet and seems unable to deal in realistic ways with the most pressing problems of families, businesses, and communities.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Members of Congress have been indicted for violating the public trust.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Public disgust with Washington is entirely warranted.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
